identity.claim_ceiling: O1-O3/J2 stated obligations only; no product law, implementation enclosure or physical admission

semantics.exact_statement: Independently verify O1 common-rotation weighted spectral bound plus exact scaling fixtures; O2 homogeneous-quaternion rotation and normalized-chart derivative/radius; O3 interval inclusive-count inequalities and exact thresholds; J2 structural rational support and Gaussian-marginal nonguassian-joint counterexample. State generic versus fixture scope explicitly.
assumptions: Hoffman-Wielandt/Mirsky component perturbation inequalities are established named lemmas; verify their common-rotation weighted combination, not simultaneous attainability.
Triangle/Cauchy-Schwarz and the quaternion double-cover angular-distance relation are named established lemmas; verify normalized-chart derivative bound.
Fixed permutation-equivariant scores and exchangeable sampling are explicit premises; no product-law admission.

target.canonical_form: exact identities and conditional inequalities under explicit named hypotheses
forbidden_shortcuts: No numerical fixture alone establishes a generic inequality.
No sibling scripts/results before own submission.
If the assigned proof cannot be supplied report unresolved, not PASS on a weaker statement.

wolfram_xact.obligation: independent derivation/simplification in Wolfram Language (+xAct for tensor work)

sympy.obligation: independent exact symbolic verification in SymPy (+ high-precision numerics where declared)

sage_singular.obligation: independent exact algebra in SageMath; Singular obligations apply to polynomial ideal/variety classes

lean.obligation: faithful formalization and compiled proof; record scope mismatch instead of silently proving a weaker theorem

independence.script_result_ownership: per-axis; scripts and outputs are never shared before adjudication
independence.correlation_disclosure: record when one LLM family authored multiple axis scripts; disclosure does not void engine evidence

exception_schema.bounded_probe: exact command + output demonstrating the blocker
exception_schema.approver: must not be the excepted axis's agent
exception_schema.registered_at: must precede the earliest axis completed_at

exceptions_adjudication.aggregate_status_rule: R0: NOT_APPLICABLE; R1/R2: PASS; R3: CAS_4AXIS_PASS; explicit R3 Rocq opt-in: CAS_5AXIS_PASS; failures: CAS_PASS_WITH_REGISTERED_EXCEPTION | CAS_CONFLICT | CAS_BLOCKED | CAS_FAIL
